A '''[[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]]''' lived a life of a hermit in the vicinity of [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Behind the scenes==
This character was depicted on the "Gungan Hermit" card of the [[Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|Champions of the Force]], the base set of the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]], which was illustrated by artists [[Florent Masurel]] and [[Jean-Sebastien Duberger]].
